content.text: A free seat can now be claimed by reservation; cancellation gives it back when the customer asks.

# Booking
reservation: a confirmed claim to a seat.
cancellation: release a reservation on request.

snapshots.completion.md: The cut is complete. Reservation now grants a claim to a free seat. Cancellation now releases that claim on request. Both visible cases pass; judgment and the whole check passed. No open findings.
